mapper.insert: INSERT INTO browse_history (account_id, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM browse_history WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT h.id, h.target_type AS targetType, h.target_id AS targetId, h.create_time AS createTime, COALESCE(w.title, r.title) AS targetTitle FROM browse_history h LEFT JOIN work w ON h.target_type = 'WORK' AND h.target_id = w.id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON h.target_type = 'REQUIREMENT' AND h.target_id = r.id WHERE h.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY h.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
